name: Muc mot nang
summary: Squid dried for one sun, a gift seafood in Báo Đồng Nai. VOV says Mực một nắng Côn Đảo received a trademark in 2020 and an OCOP three-star certificate in 2024. A cooking note was not printed. No price was printed.

howToEat: Take it as a pack. A cooking note was not printed in either report.
Fresh squid is the night-market animal. The daytime market hour was not printed. Check on arrival. No price was printed.
where: Chợ Côn Đảo, the daily market in town. VOV does not print a street for the OCOP workshop.
